items.headline: FDA approves new targeted drug for a hard-to-treat lung cancer
items.summary: The FDA approved zidesamtinib, sold as Jideytro, for previously treated ROS1-positive non-small cell lung cancer. It is a kinase inhibitor designed specifically to target tumors driven by ROS1 gene alterations.
items.why_it_matters: It gives patients with this specific lung cancer subtype, who have already been through prior treatment, a new targeted option.
